title: Juliette — details that make UI feel complete
note: Entry #1 in her design heretics collection — strong-take design posts worth keeping. The post: important details that make UI feel complete: hit areas bigger than the icon, tabular numbers on anything that changes, easing that's quick to start and gentle to land, optical alignment over mathematical alignment, nested corner radii that actually match. Why she keeps it: a five-point completeness checklist she can run against any UI, including her own portfolio build. She also noted she needs to add it as a skill.
